text: Clémentine, a young French teacher, lives with her boyfriend Lucas in [a remote country house near Bucharest|trigger|making a new home]. One night they are woken by music outside, their car is driven away, the television switches on and the tap runs, and [unseen intruders whisper and close in|threat|people who kill]. Lucas is wounded, the couple escape into the dark woods, and [flashlights move through the trees behind them|images|wild and lonely places] as they search for a way out through fences and sewers.
